lines.text: The specks are too small to see, so scientists used X rays.

post.caption: Eucalyptus leaves hold flecks of gold. In 2013, Australian scientists reported gold inside eucalyptus leaves. The work was led by CSIRO geochemist Mel Lintern. The roots reach tens of meters down and work like a pump, and the gold came from a deposit about 30 meters underground. X rays showed the specks sit inside the leaf, and saplings grown in gold laced soil took gold up too. The tree probably sheds gold into its leaves to get rid of it. Photo: Thouny, CC BY 3.0.
